Maya Chen: Quick sync — Zenith preview cohort 3 final seat confirmations. We're still missing confirmations from Lorica Tech and BlueHarbor (2 seats total). Need replies by EOD PT so we can lock training slots. Anyone on follow-ups?

Ronny Patel: I pinged BlueHarbor this morning, scheduling lead said 'confirm by COB' — I'll nudge them after lunch. @Julie can you follow up with Lorica? they had a legal question.

Julie Alvarez: On it. I have a 2pm with their CSM. I'll push for a yes and triage any legal asks. If they need SSO/contract language, I can open a JIRA.

Samir Gupta: Quick scheduling note — available training slots for this cohort: Wed 3/25 10:00 PT and Thu 3/26 09:00 PT. If we need to add a makeup it'll push into next week and may require additional CM coverage.

Zane Morgan: Flag: Lorica mentioned data residency during procurement. If legal drags this, conversion timeline might slip — recommend tagging renewal risk as medium until resolved. @Maya want me to loop Sales?

Maya Chen: Yes please loop Sales, @Zane. Also add any blockers to the shared tracker (zenith cohort tab): https://redwood.app/sheets/zenith-cohort3 — tag entries with 'zenith-cohort3' so we can filter.

OnboardBot: Calendar invite sent to BlueHarbor for Wed 3/25 10:00 PT — awaiting accept.

Ronny Patel: BlueHarbor accepted the invite :thumbsup:

Julie Alvarez: Update from my call: Lorica is tentatively in but legal wants SLA wording and clarification on data location. I shared the Private deployment checklist and asked for the exact SLA snippet they need.

Maya Chen: Ok marking Lorica as 'tentative' in the tracker. Last asks: can someone prep the onboarding quickstart and a 4-step checkpoints checklist for them? Simple playbook so they can self-serve pre-work.

Samir Gupta: I can export the onboarding playbook and drop a PDF into #customer-success-resources. ETA ~1h.

Maya Chen: Amazing — thanks team. If Lorica confirms we keep the Wed slot. I'll DM their CSM at 5pm PT if no response and escalate. Will update here when they confirm. :sparkles:
